label: STRUCTURAL_UNITY_1: Within the toy history, coordinated self-maintaining activity joined by…
definition: Within the toy history, coordinated self-maintaining activity joined by operational causal continuity across replacement of components. Such organization is represented by observable predicates and is not defined to be an individual substance.
note: An operational model component, not a sufficient metaphysical criterion for a substance. Needed to distinguish functional integration from substantial unity in #329 and #330.

formal_gap.meaning: Scenario.Integrated p, read as structural unity, says that the system at phase p shows coordinated self-maintaining activity, joined to other phases by operational causal continuity across replacement of components. It is a predicate on the two phases (early, late) of the toy turnover history in TruthCore.Mereology.Vitalism (#329), supplied by each scenario. It is an operational component, not a criterion of being one substance.
examples: Both phases of the turnover profile: the system remains integrated though every original component has been replaced.
exclusions: Substantial unity (SubstantialUnity): no inference passes from integration to substantial status; the countermodels differ exactly there (DISAMB-MEREO-UNITY).
Numerical identity of a substance across phases (Continuity is a process-level successor relation, not identity).
open_obligations: Whether structural unity is sufficient or necessary for substantial unity is the open question of #329 and #330.
No formalization candidate: the field is an observable input of the toy history.
